Definition: Type 1 persona agent for deliverable-local working sessions that produce and refine artifacts inside one deliverable folder.
Sessions executed inside one deliverable folder.
A default artifact pattern with Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, and Procedure.md as complementary documents.
Document that answers what the deliverable is; descriptive.
Document that answers what the deliverable must be; normative.
Document that answers how to think about the deliverable; directional.
Document that answers how to do the work; operational.
Optional agenda-guidance artifacts that are not treated as truth.
A lens scaffold for question-shaping that is not an authority.
An enrichment register for unresolved TBDs, conflicts awaiting rulings, and warranted enrichments.
Deliverable-local working memory shared across sessions and optionally task sub-agents.
A required table for contradictions that records conflicts and requests an explicit human ruling.
Canonical Type 2 entrypoint for bounded sub-work.
Brief field included when the method is known so TASK loads the right specialization.
Brief field used when a precise task write whitelist is useful.
TASK control surface that may be inline or file-based, with inline fields authoritative when both exist.
Deliverable identity, scope, and decomposition pointers.
Lifecycle state file that WORKING_ITEMS does not change unless explicitly instructed.
Sources list that may point to package references and maintains short source ID mappings.
Recommended citation format using path#heading-or-section whenever possible.
